candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 errors across all three correlation IDs while inventory reservations succeed (200).
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; root cause of payment 503 (config, saturation, dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns 502 with fast durations; traces consistently show payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations while inventory reservations succeed, so the failure originates downstream at payment. Payment-side evidence is absent, so the specific payment fault is not yet bounded.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics explaining the 503 on /v1/authorizations
Payment dependency health (postgresql) and error rates
Gateway logs (excluded) for upstream error detail
